metadata.title: Sharp degree bound for rational proper maps from $\mathbb B^2$ to $\mathbb B^4$
metadata.abstract: We prove D'Angelo's degree conjecture for rational proper holomorphic maps from $\mathbb{B}^2$ to $\mathbb{B}^4$, establishing the sharp degree bound of five. Suppose, to the contrary, that a rational proper map of degree six exists. We associate to the map a characteristic number measuring the degeneracy of its projective differential data. A global intersection-theoretic computation determines this number exactly, while a local analysis along the degeneracy locus yields a strictly larger lower bound for the same quantity. This contradiction excludes degree six and proves the conjectured bound.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 证明从复二维球到复四维球的有理适当映射具有尖锐次数上界五。
analysis.breakthrough: 在该维数组合中确认 D'Angelo 型尖锐次数限制。
analysis.limitations: 限有理适当映射和指定维数；不涉及任意维数或任意全纯映射的相同界。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。未见 AI 协作声明仅指这些已检查来源，不代表已核验整篇论文完全由人类完成。
analysis.priorityReason: 复几何中的尖锐刚性与交数技术有明确价值。
